title: Letter rise with recentring slide
summary: One bold oblique word builds letter by letter: each letter rises and fades in on a 1.5 fr stagger while the whole word slides left into centre, holds about one second, then smears out in 4 frames.
use_when: A section header or chapter title inside a longer film
Revealing a product name or one-word claim on a flat background
A short looping title sting for social or a site hero
Type-only openers where one word must feel deliberate

look.type_style: heavy geometric sans, oblique, all caps, cap height ~14 % H, word ~65 % W, muted slate on pale blue

structure.shot: one title word, 6 letters, built letter by letter on a flat pale background, holds centred, smears out, empty tail
structure.camera: static (word moves, frame does not; pan 0 px/s after f23)
structure.motion: f0 empty; letters rise ~0.3 em + opacity 0->1, stagger 1.5 fr (f1..f9), each easings.outExpo ~12 fr; whole word slides left ~0.32 W (~620 px @1920) into centre, easings.outQuint 22 fr, settled f23; hold f23-f54; exit f55-f58: fade + scale up ~5 % + leftward smear, easings.inExpo 4 fr; empty f59-f84

params.brand: any brand.json: heavy display font (oblique if available), muted fg on a pale bg
params.content.word: one title word or short name, 4-10 letters, one line
params.timing.stagger: frames between letter starts (default 1.5 at 30 fps)
params.loop: keep the empty head and tail so the clip loops (default true)

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips: entrance f1-f23, hold f23-f54, exit 4 fr f55-f58, 26 empty frames at the end; first and last frames are empty, so it loops. Letters rise and fade without a visible clip edge (no hard mask line). Letter spacing tightens ~4 % while settling (0.50 s vs 1.50 s keyframes). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): letter-rise-fade, recentre-slide, smear-exit. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
